summary: Selected proposal 1, the sole mechanism surviving both cross-reviews: the independent-coupling non-antipodal D4 grid Q=K(x,y,z) tensor I4. The verifier covers all 663552 labelings and 3375 positive-definite coupling triples, or 2239488000 candidates, via 145125 exact signature/Gram tests. It finds 24344064 candidates with all false Boolean NAND excesses strictly positive, with best minimum excess 3. Every such survivor still fails global shell emptiness: coordinatewise recombination of legal 001 and 011 produces two malformed 2D4* points whose energies sum to 2R^2 for every center, so at least one lies on or inside the legal radius. This is a finite rejection of the frozen independent grid, not a theorem about nonseparable Grams or arbitrary Voronoi tiles.
